decision: Restore the target IO.SYS DoubleSpace internal revision constant from 6 to 10.
evidence: SYSPRE includes ds_vers.inc and loads DS_INTERNAL_REVISION into AX before calling the DoubleSpace initialization entry.
Prior SYSPRE comparison locates the module at IO.SYS offset 33098 and identifies the differing immediate at relative offset 168 (review 041).
Target IO.SYS at file offset 0x81F1 contains B8 0A 00, the instruction mov ax,000Ah.
Isolated MASM assembly of the current SYSPRE source using the updated include lists B8 000A at module offset 00A7h and DS_INTERNAL_REVISION as 000Ah.
limitations: This verifies the single assembled instruction, not a fresh complete IO.SYS link. DBLSPACE.EXE and DBLSPACE.BIN are outside project scope; their separate version files were not changed.
